answers.reason: Q9.8 is a list item under the Q9.7 lead-in recommending SOPs defining sanitation requirements of raw materials immediately after butchering; the statement carries the 'if indicated' condition, temperature ranges and timing, at recommended strength.

Q10.3 says process monitoring tests and acceptance criteria should be established during process development; the statement matches this fully at recommended strength within the animal-derived ingredient context.

The quoted 21 CFR 211.80 text ('shall') requires written procedures describing in sufficient detail the testing of finished drug product components; the statement matches, is mandatory, and is correctly limited to finished-product plant types.
